## Common Support (PCA) and Balance (Love Plots)

```{r}
#| label: diagnostic-functions

gerar_pca <- function(matched_data, strata_name, 
                      font_family = "sans", 
                      color_ctrl = "#999999", 
                      color_trt = "#E69F00") {
  
  covariates <- matched_data %>%
    select(sexo_harm, educ_harm, activity_harm, has_car, age_group, RENDA_SM) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor), across(where(is.factor), as.numeric)) %>%
    select(where(~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))
  
  pca_res <- prcomp(covariates, scale. = TRUE)
  plot_data_pca <- matched_data %>%
    mutate(PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1], PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
           Status = ifelse(Treated == 1, "Treated", "Control (Counterfactual)"))
  
  ggplot(plot_data_pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Status, fill = Status)) +
    stat_density_2d(aes(alpha = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", bins = 5) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Control (Counterfactual)" = color_ctrl, "Treated" = color_trt)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control (Counterfactual)" = color_ctrl, "Treated" = color_trt)) +
    labs(title = paste("PCA Overlap -", strata_name)) + 
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

gerar_ps_overlap <- function(match_obj, strata_name, font_family = "sans") {
  bal.plot(match_obj, var.name = "distance", which = "both", type = "density", mirror = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = scales::alpha("#483d3f", 0.6), "1" = scales::alpha("#058ed9", 0.6))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "#483d3f", "1" = "#058ed9")) +
    labs(title = paste("P-Score Overlap (Logit) -", strata_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}

gerar_plots_tendencia <- function(strata_data, strata_name, full_data,
                                  font_family = "sans",
                                  color_ctrl_full = "#a39a92",
                                  color_trt_full = "#058ed9",
                                  color_ctrl_strata = "#483d3f",
                                  color_trt_strata = "#058ed9",
                                  linetype_full = "dashed",  
                                  linetype_strata = "solid", 
                                  y_breaks_ext = waiver(),
                                  y_breaks_int = waiver(),
                                  x_breaks = c(1997, 2007, 2017, 2023)) {
  
  full_trend <- full_data %>%
    mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(
      Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, "Treated (Full)", "Control (Full)"), Contexto = "Baseline Global")
  
  strata_trend <- strata_data %>%
    mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
    group_by(Year, Treated) %>%
    summarise(
      Extensive = weighted.mean(Y_Binary, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Intensive = weighted.mean(TOT_VIAG, w = FE_PESS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, paste("Treated", strata_name), paste("Control", strata_name)), Contexto = strata_name)
  
  plot_data <- bind_rows(full_trend, strata_trend)
  cores <- setNames(c(color_ctrl_full, color_trt_full, color_ctrl_strata, color_trt_strata),
                    c("Control (Full)", "Treated (Full)", paste("Control", strata_name), paste("Treated", strata_name)))
  
  linhas <- setNames(c(linetype_full, linetype_strata), c("Baseline Global", strata_name))
  
  custom_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) + 
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_blank() 
    )
  
  p_ext <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = Extensive, color = Grupo, linetype = Contexto)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cores) + scale_linetype_manual(values = linhas) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = y_breaks_ext) +
    labs(title = paste("Extensive Margin:", strata_name), y = "How Likely To Make a Trip", x = "Year") +
    custom_theme
    
  p_int <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = Intensive, color = Grupo, linetype = Contexto)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cores) + scale_linetype_manual(values = linhas) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks_int) +
    labs(title = paste("Intensive Margin:", strata_name), y = "Average Number of Trips (N)", x = "Year") +
    custom_theme
    
  list(ext = p_ext, int = p_int)
}

```

strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

cat("::: panel-tabset\n\n")

for (s in strata_keys) {
  cat(paste0("## ", s, "\n\n"))
  
  # --- MAHALANOBIS SUB-TAB ---
  cat("### Mahalanobis\n\n")
  
  p_pca_m <- gerar_pca(experiments[[s]]$mah$matched_data, paste(s, "(Mahalanobis)"), font_family = "NHG")
  p_love_m <- love.plot(experiments[[s]]$mah$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), title = paste("SMD -", s, "(Mah)")) + 
              theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG")
  
  print(p_pca_m)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(p_love_m)

  )
  
  print(t_mah$ext)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(t_mah$int)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  # --- LOGIT SUB-TAB ---
  cat("### Logit (Propensity Score)\n\n")
  
  p_pca_l <- gerar_pca(experiments[[s]]$log$matched_data, paste(s, "(Logit)"), font_family = "NHG")
  p_love_l <- love.plot(experiments[[s]]$log$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), title = paste("SMD -", s, "(Logit)")) + 
              theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG")
  
  print(p_pca_l)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(p_love_l)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  t_log <- gerar_plots_tendencia(
    strata_data = experiments[[s]]$log$matched_data, 
    strata_name = s, 
    full_data = experiments$Full$log$matched_data, 
    font_family = "NHG"
  )
  
  print(t_log$ext)
  cat("\n\n")
  print(t_log$int)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  p_ps <- gerar_ps_overlap(experiments[[s]]$log$match_obj, s, font_family = "NHG")
  print(p_ps)
  cat("\n\n")
}

```{r}
#| label: compare-coefficients
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Calculate 95% (1.96) and 90% (1.645) Confidence Intervals
coef_data <- master_table %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) %>% # Keep only the final treatment year evaluation
  mutate(
    # Extensive Margin CIs
    Ext_CI_95_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_95_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_Low = DiD_Ext_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    Ext_CI_90_High = DiD_Ext_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Ext_SE),
    
    # Intensive Margin CIs
    Int_CI_95_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_95_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.96 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_Low = DiD_Int_Estimate - (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    Int_CI_90_High = DiD_Int_Estimate + (1.645 * DiD_Int_SE),
    
    Strata = factor(Strata, levels = rev(unique(Strata))) # Reverse for top-to-bottom plotting
  )

# 1. Plot Extensive Margin Comparison
p_coef_ext <- ggplot(coef_data, aes(y = Strata, color = Match_Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Ext_CI_95_Low, xmax = Ext_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Ext_CI_90_Low, xmax = Ext_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mahalanobis" = "#058ed9", "Logit" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Extensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       x = "Treatment Effect Estimate (Probability of making a trip)",
       y = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 10))

# 2. Plot Intensive Margin Comparison
p_coef_int <- ggplot(coef_data, aes(y = Strata, color = Match_Type)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 1) +
  # 95% CI (Thinner, transparent)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Int_CI_95_Low, xmax = Int_CI_95_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  # 90% CI (Thicker, solid)
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = Int_CI_90_Low, xmax = Int_CI_90_High), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(aes(x = DiD_Int_Estimate), 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mahalanobis" = "#058ed9", "Logit" = "#E69F00")) +
  labs(title = "DiD Coefficient Comparison: Intensive Margin",
       subtitle = "Thick lines denote 90% CI; Thin lines denote 95% CI",
       x = "Treatment Effect Estimate (Number of Trips)",
       y = NULL,
       color = "Matching Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray30", size = 10))

print(p_coef_ext)
print(p_coef_int)

```

#| label: calculate-balance-metrics

# Extract balance summary for a specific stratum to compare numerically
# Example: S1_All
bal_mah <- bal.tab(experiments$S1_All$mah$match_obj, un = FALSE)$Balance
bal_log <- bal.tab(experiments$S1_All$log$match_obj, un = FALSE)$Balance

mean_smd_mah <- mean(abs(bal_mah$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)
mean_smd_log <- mean(abs(bal_log$Diff.Adj), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Mean Absolute SMD (S1_All)\n")
cat("Mahalanobis:", round(mean_smd_mah, 4), "\n")
cat("Logit:      ", round(mean_smd_log, 4), "\n")

```{r}

#| label: export-artefacts
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# 1. Define all strata keys (Full + 9 splits)
strata_keys <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", 
                 "S2_All", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", 
                 "S3_All", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

# 2. Loop through and export all plots
for (s in strata_keys) {
  
  # A. Export Mahalanobis and Logit outputs
  for (method in c("mah", "log")) {
    method_label <- toupper(method)
    
    # PCA
    p_pca <- gerar_pca(experiments[[s]][[method]]$matched_data, 
                       paste(s, method_label), font_family = "NHG")
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("pca_overlap_", s, "_", method, ".png")), 
           plot = p_pca, device = "png", width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
    
    # Love Plot
    p_love <- love.plot(experiments[[s]][[method]]$match_obj, binary = "std", continuous = "std", 
                        abs = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = .1), 
                        title = paste("Balanço SMD -", s, method_label)) + 
      theme_minimal(base_family = "NHG") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("love_plot_", s, "_", method, ".png")), 
           plot = p_love, device = "png", width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
    
    # Trends (Extensive & Intensive) - FIX: Added full_data parameter here
    p_trends <- gerar_plots_tendencia(
      strata_data = experiments[[s]][[method]]$matched_data, 
      strata_name = s, 
      full_data = experiments$Full[[method]]$matched_data,
      font_family = "NHG"
    )
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_extensive_", s, "_", method, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$ext, device = "png", width = 8, height = 5, bg = "white")
    
    ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("trend_intensive_", s, "_", method, ".png")), 
           plot = p_trends$int, device = "png", width = 8, height = 5, bg = "white")
  }
  
  # B. Export P-Score Overlap (Only applies to Logit)
  p_ps <- gerar_ps_overlap(experiments[[s]]$log$match_obj, s, font_family = "NHG")
  ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", paste0("pscore_overlap_", s, ".png")), 
         plot = p_ps, device = "png", width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
}

write_csv(master_table, here("outputs", "tables", "master_sample_table-9s.csv"))
message("(EN) All Vector Plots (.png) for Mahalanobis and Logit methods were exported to 'outputs/'!")


```
